reviews.ex-em-wave-equation-prerequisites-source: Recomputed constant source h=1 giving c2t2/2, compact-source propagation outside radius1+ct, and linear velocity datum b=x1 giving u=(t-t0)x1 with energy integral at least4R5/3, infinite even initially. Smooth nondecaying/arbitrary-growth data remain admitted by local Kirchhoff uniqueness, whereas the energy-uniqueness branch still requires finite initial energy and its separately stipulated sharp conservation; the published Duhamel source class retains its actual per-slice compactness condition. Added the missing explicit Euclidean triangle supplier and proved the closed support threshold using continuity of h0 from the exterior. Original Example unchanged.
reviews.lem-em-retarded-wave-kernel: Read full functional/distribution, exact cone support including apex, compact-spacetime convolution, adjoint pairing, and WK=delta arguments. Recomputed integrable radial singularity, polar normalization, source-time substitution including c2 cancellation, absolute Fubini bounds, local slab extension for every observation point and weak mollifier limit. Corrected zero-test empty support, observation-time bound [-M,M] in the triple integral, and averaging continuity: compact mollifier support and continuity of the adjoint pairing at0 suffice directly, without incorrectly assuming it continuous globally. WK is established through weak continuity of distributional derivatives. Countable Choice and singular/nonfunction kernel qualifications retained; no statement narrowing.
reviews.lem-em-smooth-forced-maxwell-cauchy-syst: Independently rederived smooth component wave sources WE=-grad rho/epsilon-mu Jt, WB=mu curl J, residual waves WR=WQ=0 and all four zero initial residual data from the constraints/continuity equation. Corrected the harmless sign in the residual derivative coefficient. For any competing first-order solution, Gauss defects now follow directly by divergence and zero time derivative, with explicit constant-function supplier, before obtaining its wave equations and using uniqueness. Closed-cone dependence retains derivative equality on the dense cone interior and continuity at its boundary/apex. The proof remains for arbitrary-growth extension-sense smooth sources/data with no finite-energy or decay assumption. Corrected inaccurate Remarks saying unconstrained first-order Gauss defects are homogeneous waves; they are time-constant defects. Original Statement unchanged.
reviews.thm-em-retarded-point-distributional-max: Checked global all-time uniform subluminal C3 history, proper point-current and explicit retarded-history pairings; no ordinary distribution action on a noncompact adjoint test is used. Verified adjoint test differentiation, translated WK identity, compact history pullback and total-derivative Lorenz cancellation. For local integrability inserted the missing Jacobian kappa<=1+v*/c into the substitution estimate; potential derivatives and fields have r^-2+r^-1 bounds on each compact observation window using only local acceleration bounds. Removed an erroneous proof-only claim that first derivatives of fields are locally integrable (Coulomb derivatives can be r^-3), retaining the required potential first derivatives and fields. The moving shell cutoff gives O(epsilon) boundary error, so first distributional derivatives of potentials equal regular extensions; full Maxwell identities follow by commuting distributional derivatives, and continuous residuals vanish pointwise off Gamma. No source deletion, self-energy, acceleration-global-bound or free-addition uniqueness claim. Original Statement unchanged.
reviews.ex-em-causal-wave-kernel-prerequisites-e: Recomputed static root t-|x|/c, C/|x| potential, zero vector potential and Coulomb field, and the extension of compact-spacetime kernel formula to a static compact spatial source by time cutoffs on each compact observation window. Verified chi=-|x|2/6, Wchi=1, transformed diagonal potential (2x1/3,-x2/3,-x3/3) with Lorenz divergence0 and unchanged zero fields, and homogeneous difference from the zero-Cauchy-data gauge function. Added the explicit arbitrary-neighbourhood bump argument for apex support; nonnegative integrability and arbitrary small bump supplies support, not merely one test. Original Example unchanged.
reviews.thm-em-retarded-root-and-fields: Read all four clauses and argument. Matched C3, all-time uniform bound and inferred v*>=0 to the global root supplier; independently checked emission Jacobian1-n dot beta and inverse derivative identities. Exact retarded-history integrals, denominators, regular zero extensions and C2 potentials/C1 fields match the corrected point supplier. Recomputed signed velocity/acceleration split and bound |C|(1+v*/c)/(1-v*/c)3 r^-2. On x_r=z(s0)+rn,t_r=s0+r/c root uniqueness identifies s0 and excludes the worldline, so the rE remainder is direction-uniform O(1/r), without a global acceleration bound, time-uniform leading term or finite-energy/flux inference. No carrier edit was needed; full original Statement retained.
reviews.ex-em-wave-equation-prerequisites-hypoth: Recomputed travelling-wave derivatives and Wu=0, transverse unbounded support and exact divergent L2 box lower bound for nonzero compact profile. Fixed the closed-interval continuity margin and explicitly included f=0. Infinite L2 of u alone does not establish infinite wave energy, so added the MVT witness f-prime nonzero and an independent derivative-profile box bound for e=c2|f-prime(x1-ct)|2; finite-energy failure is now proved rather than inferred from u-L2. Preserved smooth arbitrary-growth wave conclusion. Recomputed the all-time curve sqrt(c2s2+a2), its strictly subluminal finite-time speed with supremum c, missing origin root, kappa approaching0 at negative infinity, and on-worldline unique root s=t. Adopted the precheck-proposed dependency ordering/renumbering; original Example unchanged.
